limitations: Backend-agnostic skeleton only. The first-hand field notes are Ascend-specific and live in the ascend-video-diffusion-optimization skill; every operator, layout and profiler reference (TransData, FRACTAL_NZ, CANN) must be re-derived per backend.
Candidate workflow guidance; not independently validated.
Model identifiers, campaign revisions, and numeric gates are intentionally excluded and remain issue-scoped.

Only declared references are required; other cross-skill links are navigation.
